title: Setup mirror to route Sentry traffic to
author: sentrivana
body_preview:
There are parts of Sentry that need to send envelopes to a different DSN to avoid cycles. Currently, this is done via a custom multiplexing transport. Instead, we want to send to one mirror which will determine which instance to send to.

This issue is about creating the ops PR to configure the mirror (see comment). getsentry/sentry-python#6533 is then the Sentry codebase cleanup part.

title: Get rid of multiplexing transport in Sentry
author: sentrivana
body_preview:
There are parts of Sentry that need to send envelopes to a different DSN to avoid cycles. Currently, this is done via a custom multiplexing transport. Instead, we want to send to one mirror which will determine which instance to send to.

This issue assumes the mirror from getsentry/sentry-python#6534 has been set up and the goal is to get rid of the custom transport code in Sentry.
